name: Columbina

abilities.name: Moondew Cascade

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.
If you have at least 1 **Verdant Dew**, Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Moondew Cleanse, which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack

If you have at least 1 **Verdant Dew**, Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Moondew Cleanse, which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

abilities.name: Eternal Tides

_curatorNotes: Gravity Ripple continuous DMG: gcsim skill.go skillTick / skillTickTask, 117-frame interval (1.95s), skillDoT[9]=0.16848 = 16.8% Max HP @T10 (UseHP). First tick 117f after the skill lands (spawn+interval), so firstTickDelay defaults to interval. AoE radius widens 4->6 at Moonsign level >=2 (not modeled).

Gravity Interference (Lunar-Charged variant): gcsim skill.go gravityTick, skillLC[9]=0.084672 = 8.47% Max HP @T10, Electro, UseHP. Fires once when accumulated Gravity reaches its limit (60), which takes ~6s of continuous party Lunar reactions (Gravity accrues 10/s, +34% at C2). Only ONE of the three Gravity Interference variants fires per trigger — the Lunar reaction type that accumulated the most Gravity, decided at runtime. Manual trigger + caveat because reaction cadence is not simulable.

Gravity Interference (Lunar-Bloom variant): gcsim skillLB[9]=0.025344 = 2.53% Max HP @T10 per hit, Dendro, 5 hits (skillHitmarksLB has 5 entries). Only fires if Lunar-Bloom is the dominant accumulated reaction. See the Lunar-Charged variant note for trigger cadence.

Gravity Interference (Lunar-Crystallize variant): gcsim skillLCr[9]=0.158832 = 15.88% Max HP @T10, Geo, UseHP. Only fires if Lunar-Crystallize is the dominant accumulated reaction. See the Lunar-Charged variant note for trigger cadence. C4 adds Max-HP-scaled flat DMG to this hit (see C4 notes).

abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the three off-field Gravity Interference hits. They fire only when Gravity fills from party Lunar reactions (about every 6s), and only the one matching the dominant reaction lands.
abilities.description:
Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and summoning **Gravity Ripple**.
Gravity Ripple will follow the active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. While Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will accrue a special Gravity. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, different types of damage will be dealt to enemies based on the type of Lunar Reaction that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Gravity Ripple inflicts AoE Hydro DMG over a wider area.
_curatorNotes: Frames 2026-07-14 from gcsim skill.go: skillFrames = InitAbilSlice(41); ActionCharge=40, Skill=28, Burst=28, Dash=27, Jump=32, Swap=26. swap=ActionSwap=26; N=InitAbilSlice default 41 (ActionAttack not overridden). CD: SetCDWithDelay(action.ActionSkill, 17*60, 20) -> cooldown 17s, cooldownStartDelay 20. Skill self-DMG skill[9]=0.30096=30.1% Max HP (Hydro, hitmark 21) follows the FrameMap convention, not authored as an effect.
Behavior corrected instant (genshin-db stub had duration:25 on an instant skill — moved to the Gravity Ripple summon which carries the 25s window; Gravity Ripple Duration row confirms 25.0s).

abilities.name: Moonlit Melancholy
abilities.caveat: One in-game bonus, shown as three Reaction Bonus lines — one per Lunar reaction. It applies only while the active character stays in the domain, though shown for the full window.
abilities.description: Hills and tides unite under the silver light of a pristine new moon. Temporarily transforms the surrounding terrain into **Lunar Domain**, dealing  AoE Hydro DMG.
_curatorNotes: Frames 2026-07-14 from gcsim burst.go: burstFrames = InitAbilSlice(131); ActionCharge=130, Skill=122, Dash=122, Jump=124, Swap=122. swap=122; N=131 (ActionAttack default). CD: SetCD(action.ActionBurst, 15*60) -> 15s, no delay. Energy cost 60 (data_gen/sidecar; EnergyMax 60). burstHitmark=110 (self Hydro hit, burst[9]=0.58032=58.0% Max HP, UseHP). burstField=86 -> summon spawnsAt (field buff checks begin). burstDur=20*60=20s. Modeled as an instant burst spawning a stationary 'Lunar Domain' summon (spawnsAt 86, 20s) — the Shrine-of-Maya shape — rather than a legacy persistent burst bar, so the field reads as its own lane.

Lunar Reaction DMG Bonus burstBuff[9]=0.40=40% @T10, applied to every party member via AddReactBonusMod for Lunar-tagged attacks while the active player is within the domain area (re-checked every 0.8s, 1.2s per application -> modeled as 20s refresh). RE-KEYED 2026-07-29 to the lunar*ReactionBonus stat family (bucket-5 Reaction Bonus, additive with the EM bonus) per Nate's ruling — the bucket-5 primitive now exists; the old lunar*DmgBonus keying conflated it with the bucket-3 Base DMG bracket.

passives.name: Law of the New Moon
passives.description:
When characters within the **Lunar Domain** trigger Lunar reactions, they will gain the following effects respectively: 
· Lunar-Charged: When the Thundercloud performs lightning strike(s) against a valid target, it has a 33% chance to perform an additional lightning strike. 
· Lunar-Bloom: When triggering Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party gains a special **Moonridge Dew**. Up to 3 Moonridge Dews can be gained every 18s. 
· Lunar-Crystallize: When Moondrift Harmony is triggered, every Moondrift has a 33% chance to inflict an extra attack.
_curatorNotes: A4 (Ascension 4): gcsim asc.go a4* — Lunar-Charged +33% extra lightning-strike chance and Lunar-Crystallize +33% extra Moondrift are reaction-mechanic damage multipliers with no schema primitive; Lunar-Bloom generates Moonridge Dew (feeds her Verdant Dew Charged Attack) up to 3 per 18s. All require party Lunar reactions the planner cannot simulate — left as description-only (unmodelable procs).

passives.name: Lunar Vigil
passives.description:
If one of your party members is incapacitated while in the Nod-Krai or Frost Moon regions, Columbina will revive this character. The amount of HP the character will have upon revival is based on Columbina's Friendship Level. This effect can occur once every 100s. This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
Additionally, Columbina appears to have a special affinity for certain animals who are influenced by kuuvahki...
_curatorNotes: Passive4 'Lunar Vigil' ingested from genshin-db 5.2.12 (capability sweep 2026-07-28). Effect-empty by design: revival HP scales with Friendship Level (account progression — no talent-level-10 value exists), no revive/on-death trigger primitive exists, and the effect is disabled in Domains, Trounce Domains, and the Spiral Abyss (all instanced combat). Not implemented in gcsim (no match in ~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/columbina/).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Revival has no timeline representation of any kind — there is no death, no HP and no party-state surface anywhere in the planner, so nothing on screen is wrong or missing. It is also disabled in every instanced fight a rotation is planned for, and its magnitude depends on Friendship Level, which the tool has no notion of. Pure kit trivia in a 262px column. Category: invisible-omission.

constellations.name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
constellations.description:
Unleashing her Elemental Skill Eternal Tides will immediately trigger an effect equivalent to the effect of **Gravity Interference**. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
When Gravity Interference is triggered, if the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· Lunar-Charged: Your current active character will recover 6 Energy.
· Lunar-Bloom: Your active character's interruption resistance will be increased for 8s.
· Lunar-Crystallize: Summons a Rainsea Shield. The Rainsea Shield's DMG absorption is based on 12% of Columbina's Max HP, and it will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness for 8s.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is **elevated** by 1.5%.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the Rainsea Shield or the interruption resistance boost — only one branch fires per Gravity Interference, chosen by the dominant Lunar reaction.
_curatorNotes: C1: gcsim cons.go c1OnSkill (E cast -> gravityTick, 15s ICD) and c1OnGravityTick — Lunar-Charged: active +6 energy; Lunar-Crystallize: Rainsea Shield HP=0.12*MaxHP, 8s (shield.ColumbinaC1, self-targeted). Lunar-Bloom interruption-res branch is kit text (gcsim models the LC/LCr branches). All gated on Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam -> teamFaction moonsign min:2. Manual triggers because Gravity Interference cadence is unmodelable. Elevate increment +1.5% (gcsim elevation[1]=0.015).
Prior stub had a spurious C1 damage effect (12% HP hydro) — C1 adds no new damage scaling (it re-triggers the base Gravity Interference); removed.
[A7] Rainsea Shield's 250% Hydro-DMG absorption effectiveness is not modeled; it is shown as a generic 12% Max HP shield.

↻ 2026-08-18: the [A7] line above is WRONG about the fallback — the Rainsea Shield is not shown as a generic shield, it is not shown AT ALL, at any constellation level. All three C1 branches are `trigger: 'manual'`, and `manual` reaches no surface anywhere: `pushShield` (sim/shields.ts:111-115) requires `onCast` with a positive `duration`, and the only `'manual'` mention in src is the type declaration itself (types/ability.ts:649) — no collector, no proc, no chip, no notation token. So the 250% Hydro absorption is a second-order gap on a shield that never draws, and the ability-level `caveat` (which DOES render, gated to C1+) already states the real absence. ⚠️ The constellation-shield wire (53db108) does NOT reach this — it only widened the `onCast` walk to non-ability effect sources; docs/curation/engine-capability-rubric.md P26 names Columbina C1 as one of the five non-ability shields that still draw nothing. ⏭ The blocker is unchanged and is not the shield primitive: Gravity Interference cadence has no primitive, which is why these are `manual` in the first place.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Not modeled: the shield, 6 Energy, and interruption resistance — only one of the three fires per Gravity Interference, chosen by the dominant Lunar reaction."

constellations.description:
Rate of accumulating **Gravity** increases by 34%. 
When Gravity Interference is triggered, Columbina will receive the Lunar Brilliance effect, which increases her Max HP by 40% for 8s.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:
When Lunar Brilliance is active, if, during the current trigger of Gravity Interference, the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· Lunar-Charged: ATK of your current active character increases. Increase in ATK is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.
· Lunar-Bloom: Elemental Mastery of your current active character increases. Increase in Elemental Mastery is equal to 0.35% of Columbina's Max HP.
· Lunar-Crystallize: DEF of your current active character increases. Increase in DEF is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is **elevated** by 7%.
_curatorNotes: C2 re-authored 2026-07-14 (replaces flagged broken stub). gcsim cons.go c2Init/c2OnGravityTick: c2Buff HPP=0.4 (Lunar Brilliance +40% Max HP, 8s, self, applied on every Gravity Interference regardless of Moonsign). Active-char conversions gated on Moonsign level >=2 (teamFaction moonsign min:2): ATK += 0.01*MaxHP (ratio 1), EM += 0.0035*MaxHP (ratio 0.35), DEF += 0.01*MaxHP (ratio 1) — all flat stats scaling on Columbina's Max HP, 8s, mutually exclusive by dominant reaction. Elevate increment +7% (gcsim elevation[2]=0.085 cumulative; C1 1.5 + C2 7 = 8.5). +34% gravity rate (c2GravityRate) unmodeled — no gravity primitive.
NOTE: ability.ts stat-key JSDoc credits 'Columbina C2 per-reaction-element CRIT DMG' — that is actually C6 (CRIT DMG); C2 does ATK/EM/DEF conversions. Comment mislabel, not editable from this file.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Four authored buffs (self +40% Max HP, and active-target ATK/EM/DEF conversions) are all manual-trigger, so her row and the active character's row draw no bars where the game gives a stack of them every ~6s. The +34% Gravity accrual rate has no pixel at all — Gravity is not a bar, a meter or a marker anywhere in the tool, so a rate change to it cannot look wrong. Category: expected-but-absent.

Flat add belongs on the Gravity Interference (skill) damage but is reaction-conditional and would need a Max-HP flatScaling on an unmodelable-timing hit; left as a note. ↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — in both halves. Energy regain is rendered nowhere in the planner. And the second half is a DAMAGE MAGNITUDE folded into an existing hit — the tool never prints damage numbers by constitution, and the hit itself is the already-caveated Gravity Interference, so nothing changes size, colour or position on screen whether C4 is owned or not. constellations.name: Through Darkness Led by Moonlight
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the +80% CRIT DMG party members get for 8s after a Lunar reaction inside the Lunar Domain — no bar draws for it.
constellations.description:
For 8s after characters in the **Lunar Domain** trigger a Lunar reaction, based on the elements involved in the reaction, the CRIT DMG of the corresponding Elemental DMG done by all party members is increased by 80%. The CRIT DMG-increasing effects for the same Elemental Type do not stack.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is **elevated** by 7%.
_curatorNotes: C6: gcsim cons.go c6Init — c6Buff CD=0.8 (+80% CRIT DMG) added per element bucket keyed by the triggering Lunar reaction (LC->Electro+Hydro, LB->Dendro+Hydro, LCr->Geo+Hydro), 8s, requires the burst's Lunar Domain react-bonus mod active. Authored as generic team critDmg 80 with caveat (element-specific critDmg stats would need runtime knowledge of which reaction fired). Elevate increment +7% (gcsim elevation[6]=0.20 cumulative).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — A +80% team CRIT DMG bar is the single largest buff in her kit and no bar draws — the effect is authored but manual-trigger. A C6 owner casting Q and seeing only the three Reaction Bonus rows would reasonably assume the tool has it covered. Trimmed only to drop the worked Lunar-Charged example, which is kit explanation and not needed to read the blank row. Category: expected-but-absent.

↻ CAVEAT RESTORED 2026-09-15 (essential-characters T0; the interim Nate set in essential-characters §6.3 while `docs/stack-threshold-round.md` is open). The removal note below filed it expected-but-absent — the category name-the-pixel KEEPS — and since the Team Builder stopped deriving `manual` effects the same day, the blank is now undisclosed on both surfaces. ⚠️ C6 is NOT a Gravity mechanic and is not waiting on that round: gcsim c6Init subscribes OnLunarCharged/OnLunarBloom/OnLunarCrystallize, requires the burst's react-bonus mod (burstBuffKey) to be active, and grants 8s AttackMods keyed per reaction to its elements — LC → Electro+Hydro, LB → Dendro+Hydro, LCr → Geo+Hydro. The stats exist (`electroCritDmg`, `hydroCritDmg`, `dendroCritDmg`, `geoCritDmg`), so the shape is four `onReaction` source-team buffs (Hydro on the three-reaction array, one element each), duration 8, refresh. ⛔ TRIED IN MEMORY AND NOT SHIPPED: the only gate available is `state: duringSummon`, which the onReaction buff pass cannot resolve (§1.G) — measured, `Columbina C > Fischl E Q > Barbara E` (no summon of hers at all) drew seven +80% bars. Without a burst-window gate it would claim the buff in every Lunar rotation. Unblocks with a resolvable summon/burst-window condition on that pass.

Full curation 2026-07-14 (stub -> curated). Effects + FrameMaps from gcsim internal/characters/columbina/ (frame origin: gcsim main, merged) cross-checked against docs/curation/talents/columbina.json. Web: KQM Columbina quickguide + genshin wiki.

No Lunar-conversion / Moonsign-level / lunar-base-DMG primitive exists — excluded per extraPassive convention, flagged. (2) Gravity accumulation system (10/s, +34% C2, 60 limit) has no primitive; Gravity Interference off-field hits use manual triggers. (3) Verdant Dew / Moondew Cleanse CA gated on external party-generated resource.
